title: DUET: Optimize Token-Budget Allocation for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2605.08441v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) generates hundreds of thousands of tokens per training step, with rollout generation dominating the computational cost. The overall token budget can be controlled along two main dimensions: (i) deciding which prompts to allocate rollouts to, and (ii) deciding how long each rollout should be. Prior work has generally controlled only one of these dimensions at a time. We show that jointly tuning both decisions under a shared compute budget improves both reasoning quality and wall-clock training time. We instantiate this view as \textbf{DU}al-controlled tok\textbf{E}n alloca\textbf{T}ion (DUET), a computationally efficient layer over GRPO that uses a lightweight pre-rollout surrogate of prompt informativeness to set how many rollouts each prompt receives, and a marker-gated abort rule with importance reweighting to set when to stop them. translated_title: DUET：为可验证奖励强化学习优化Token预算分配
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）在每个训练步会生成数十万个token，其中rollout生成占据了主要计算成本。整体token预算可以沿两个主要维度进行控制：（i）决定将rollout分配给哪些prompt；（ii）决定每个rollout的生成长度。以往的工作通常每次只控制其中一个维度。我们证明，在共享计算预算下联合调整这两个决策，可以同时提升推理质量和实际训练时间。我们将这一观点实现为双重控制Token分配（DUal-controlled tokEn allocaTion，DUET），这是一个构建在GRPO之上的计算高效层：它使用轻量级的rollout前prompt信息量代理指标来设定每个prompt获得多少rollout，并使用带重要性重加权的标记门控中止规则来设定何时终止rollout。在基于MATH数据集训练的Qwen3-1.7B模型上，DUET的表现优于……（原文此处被截断）
tldr: 提出DUET方法，在GRPO基础上联合控制rollout分配给哪些prompt以及每个rollout的生成长度这两个维度，在共享计算预算下同时提升可验证奖励强化学习的推理质量和实际训练速度。
en_tdlr: DUET is a computationally efficient layer over GRPO that jointly controls which prompts receive rollouts (via a lightweight pre-rollout informativeness surrogate) and when to stop each rollout (via a marker-gated abort rule with importance reweighting), improving both reasoning quality and wall-clock training time for RLVR under a shared compute budget.
